independent_replication.role: retrospective evaluation; not a new confirmation

primary.estimand: mean SCM-paired regret difference; left policy minus right policy

policy_rules.candidate_universe: saved initial DAG-legal M4 candidate rows only; no new candidate generation
policy_rules.m4: max M4_gain; ties within 1e-12 resolved by canonical pair then operation
policy_rules.type_ranked: apply development SCM-balanced mean observed regret reduction order; among currently legal positive-M4 candidates choose highest-priority available error type, within type max M4_gain then canonical pair/operation; if no type has eligible candidate, frozen M4 fallback
policy_rules.type_priority_source: Development SCM-balanced single-edit mean regret reduction by type, descending; lexical type tie-break
policy_rules.t5_guided: max saved T5_gain; require gain > 1e-12; then M4_gain secondary within 1e-12; canonical pair/operation; fallback to M4 if no positive T gain
policy_rules.regret_oracle: max saved regret reduction versus no-op; diagnostic only and outcome privileged

scope_limitations: Candidate rows are initial one-edit records; dynamic B=2-4 policy trajectories are not reconstructed in this analysis.
Only Development and 160-SCM replication cohorts are used for the primary descriptive comparison.
No new SCM, graph, observation, or evaluator response is generated.
Intervals are pointwise and not multiplicity-adjusted; no equivalence or noninferiority claim.
